author: lSoG
content: Decision: grouped the four new forge-tier item kinds under ONE additive Item::Forge(ForgeItem{PropFn,Lemma,Proof,Witness}) variant rather than four top-level Item variants. Rationale: bounds the cross-crate exhaustive-match ripple to ONE inert arm per site (mirroring the ADT-decl arms) since the items have no v1 consumer yet (covenant 2b, battery 2c, proof view 2e, library 3); still 'adds the AST Item variants' the spec calls for, as ForgeItem sub-variants; keeps the thermite-syntax-only scope tight.
